subject: 171 Arlington Street Notice of Intent
overview: The Commission approved a Notice of Intent for a residential addition at 171 Arlington Street and discussed upcoming meeting schedules and commission vacancies.

items.title: 171 Arlington Street Notice of Intent
items.summary: Approved the abbreviated notice of intent to construct a rear addition and deck, adding a condition that all new vegetation other than lawn grass must be native species.

items.title: Staff Updates and Scheduling
items.summary: The Commission discussed potential upcoming filings, adjusted the October meeting calendar to avoid scheduling conflicts, and shared updates on recruiting new members.
